notes.title: Rapid Eye Madness is Now Available!
notes.notes:
After 4 months of hard work, Team Moonstorm presents: Rapid Eye Madness!

Get ready for a grim & cute collection of mini-games that are as cryptic as they are engaging! Survive the games to unlock Audio Logs, learn their patterns, and beat this eldritch nightmare before you fall victim to its otherwordly schemes.

Rapid Eye Madness was built as part of the Indie Game Academy's Level 3 program. All proceeds for the game go directly to future IGA scholarships. Your purchase will help other devs learn the ropes of the industry in IGA's generous programs!
